{{Quote|Our most popular salad, featuring crisp Revwien lettuce garnished with topatoes, space-carrots, Qiraadishes, Mandalorian oranges, Sriluurian raisins and Wol Cabasshews. Served with Luptoomian dressing.|The description of interstellar garden salad in the menu from Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Mandalorian oranges''' were a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] used in cooking. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] located in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], served the oranges as part of a dish named [[interstellar garden salad]], which he considered delicious. The [[Salad/Legends|salad]] also included crisp [[Revwien lettuce]], [[Topato/Legends|topatoes]], [[Carrot/Legends|space carrots]], [[Qiraadish]]es, [[Sriluurian raisin]]s, and [[Wol Cabasshew]]s, with [[Luptoomian dressing]] and the option to add grilled [[Gornt/Legends|Gornt]] meat for an extra credit. The salad cost 5.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was the most popular salad served at Dex's,<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] with which the fruit shared its name were a warrior culture based around the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalorian oranges were introduced in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article, [[Dining at Dex's]], which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
